title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Training MSE
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model complexity is reduced, which can lead to an increase in training error because the model may not fit the training data as closely.

title: Analyzing the Effect
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO affects the model's ability to fit the training data.
